newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end lower on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end lower on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates closed lower on Monday amid excess liquidity and are likely to remain low on Tuesday, dealers said.

Onvernight funds were initially traded in the range of 2.5 and 2.75 percent, but came down later in the day, touching the bottom of 1.5 percent at the end of play, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The market is likely to remain liquid until the start of the traditionally dry month of December, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
